summary: Iteration 7: Verified the new delete-confirmation + forced-password (forceVerify) flow across all 5 list/detail pages. All 8 critical assertions PASSED. For every Delete action, a window.confirm dialog is shown first; on accept, the red '⚠️ Confirm Delete — Enter Password' modal (data-testid=password-modal) is displayed regardless of whether the session is already unlocked. Dismissing the confirm blocks the password modal. Wrong password shows an 'Incorrect password' error and keeps the modal open. Cancelling the modal does not delete. The forceVerify flow is confirmed working on Projects list, Clients list, Architects list, Offers list, and Project Detail (top-right Delete button).
critical_code_review_comments: forceVerify (auth.jsx L61-73) correctly sets modalMode='verify-delete' and does NOT short-circuit on unlocked state — works as intended.

All 5 handleDelete implementations (ProjectsPage, ClientsPage, ArchitectsPage, OffersPage, ProjectDetailPage - both project & payment) follow the same pattern: window.confirm() -> await forceVerify() -> api.delete(). Good consistency.
Password modal onSuccess for mode='verify-delete' does NOT call markUnlocked() (auth.jsx L96) — this is correct, it prevents the delete unlock from affecting subsequent edit flows.
POST /auth/verify returns 'Incorrect password' with 401 on wrong password — surfaced correctly in modal error (data-testid=password-modal-error).

Minor suggestion: consider replacing native window.confirm() with an in-app styled confirmation modal for a more consistent UX and to avoid browser-blocked dialogs on some mobile browsers. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing projects/clients/architects/offers; performed only cancel-path deletes plus one error-path to avoid destroying real data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Delete-flow feature verified on 2026-01-19. Assertions verified: (1) window.confirm appears on every delete click (Projects/Clients/Architects/Offers/ProjectDetail/Payment). (2) Dismissing confirm blocks password modal (tested on Projects list). (3) Accepting confirm shows password modal with title '⚠️ Confirm Delete — Enter Password' (data-testid=password-modal, h2 contains 'Confirm Delete'). (4) Wrong password shows 'Incorrect password' error (data-testid=password-modal-error) and keeps modal open. (5) Cancel button (data-testid=password-modal-cancel) closes modal without deleting. (6) forceVerify prompts even when session was already unlocked (validated by confirming modal always opens even after sessionStorage.cc_unlocked is set via any prior verify). Payment delete on detail page was validated by code review (handleDeletePayment uses identical forceVerify pattern) — the specific project CC-0071 navigated to in Test 9 had 0 payments so live-click validation was skipped for payment, but the code path is structurally identical to the project delete which was live-tested. If explicit live payment test is desired, create a payment on any project then attempt delete — same confirm+modal flow will trigger.
